title: Repositories by field and profession, role-filtered experience, research, associative stack, art, blog archive and links matrix rain
body:
Fixes #7

## Summary

This turns the one-page CV into a multi-page site with six new pages: `/repositories/`, `/experience/`, `/research/`, `/associative/`, `/art/` and `/blog/`. Every page is drawn on a new background, bottom to top: a WebGL gas nebula with stars, a grid, and a matrix rain of links-visuals symbols for every configuration of 1–4 links. All data is collected again and more accurately: only original repositories, 33 package registries, 73 languages.

The full analysis is in [`docs/case-studies/issue-7/README.md`](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-7-ede7c165bf5d/docs/case-studies/issue-7/README.md). It covers:
- the issue quote and every requirement, each with its solution, evidence and status;
- the collected data;
- the root causes;
- the blocked items;
- the online research and existing components (links-visuals, twittermatrix, OEIS A054050, the Habr API, the X embed, react-tweet, the Telegram post widget, VK.Widgets.Post).

## Requirements

| # | Requirement | What was done |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | Separate page for all repositories, summary of usefulness per field | `/repositories/`: 18 field cards with summaries and a searchable catalog filtered by field (`?field=…&q=…`) |
| R2 | Best repository examples for MLOps, DevOps, ML/AI and other professions | 13 professions with 7–10 curated original repositories each |
| R3 | LinksPlatform started around 2010 | The timeline starts in 2010-03; the `archive` branch has materials from 28.03.2010–04.11.2010 |
| R4 | No "1,460 public repositories", no forks | 525 original repositories: 184 personal + 341 in 15 organizations. Forks, 89 client copies, 96 mirrors and noise are excluded |
| R5 | Check other registries, the full spectrum | 33 registries checked. Packages: npm 222, crates.io 35, NuGet 62, Docker Hub 63, GitHub Packages 103, PyPI 5, Go 3, Nimble 2, Homebrew 1. The 24 empty registries are listed as checked, and none is left unchecked |
| R6 | Many more languages and technologies | Language cloud of 73 languages by bytes (21 before), 130 skills (81 before) |
| R7 | Deep.GPT timeline | Deep.GPT (Deep.Assistant), 2024-05 to now: question answering, image and music generation, API gateway |
| R8 | Focus on link-foundation/meta-theory | Meta-theory section on the home page and a detailed one on `/research/` |
| R9 | Floating Habr cards with live views, karma, bookmarks | 13 Deep.Foundation and Konard articles; statistics refresh from the Habr API in the browser (it allows CORS) |
| R10 | Deduplicated blog feed from X, Telegram and VK with embeds; X for English readers, VK for Russian readers | `/blog/`: 63 posts in 51 stories, chosen by reader language (`navigator.language` or `?lang=`); official X embed on demand |
| R11 | Archive posts with all formatting, shown without embeds | Sanitized HTML, links, reposts and media. Pictures are saved to `public/archive/media/` because VK CDN links expire within a day |
| R12 | Expand languages and technologies | Same as R6 |
| R13 | Experience filtered by ML/AI, DevOps, CEO/Team lead, Developer | `/experience/?role=ml\|devops\|lead\|developer\|research` |
| R14 | Problem solving algorithm and meta-theory with the image or SVG | An SVG redraw of the algorithm image, with a link to the original |
| R15, R16 | Symbols of every 1–4 link configuration, all the same size, matrix rain; universe → grid → rain → infographics | 1 + 10 + 129 + 2,836 = 2,976 symbols (OEIS A054050) in one 100×100 box; nebula shader, grid, canvas rain, then the content; reduced motion respected |
| R17 | Pages for the associative stack and for art and other projects | `/associative/` (layers from the theory up to AI) and `/art/` (art, symbol gallery, uncategorized repositories) |
| R18 | tsp, p-vs-np, physics; data science on laws | `/research/` highlights and a "Data science: laws" section |
| R19 | Case study | [`docs/case-studies/issue-7`](https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/blob/issue-7-ede7c165bf5d/docs/case-studies/issue-7) |
| R20 | Single PR | This PR |

## Known limits (details in the case study, section 6)

- **GitHub Packages:** download counts are approximate, because the token lacks `read:packages`.
- **X:** the timeline needs a login, so tweets are added by URL in `post-urls.txt`.
- **Telegram:** `t.me/drakonard` is a personal account with no public channel to archive.
- **VK embeds:** they need a per-post hash that only logged-in users get, so VK posts are shown from the archive.
- **Missing VK pictures:** 2 VK pictures return 404 even on the live post. They show a "Picture no longer available" note.

## How to verify

```sh
npm ci
npm run check      # lint, format, secrets, file size
npx vitest run     # 104 tests
npm run build
```

Tests check that:
- the committed `github.json` and `repositories.json` match the collector output;
- forks and copies are excluded;
- every curated example is an existing original repository;
- registries without a public listing are checked;
- the 1/10/129/2836 configuration counts are correct and every symbol has the same size;
- the blog shows each story once, X for English readers and VK for Russian readers;
- archived pictures are local files and are what the page shows;
- a picture the CDN no longer serves becomes a note;
- the experience page filters by every role.
